test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option which has the same relation to the third term as the second term is to the first term.

LARGE : MASHE :: WATER : _____
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bd594009c35a4f52dc93b534b7410355baabcbc39dc8c541057b5898c296ca7.png] 

 
• **Consonants are increased by +1.**
 
• **Vowels remains same.**

LARGE : MASHE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25ba0177e40254404b06b2341f21962550b70b9232795852bbb6a526b7e751e1.png] 

Similarly,

WATER : ?

 
• Consonants are increased by +1.
 
• Vowels remains same.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27a54fb459e0df87c692f60a751da6c536c8fc45bc1972ae2d77bf63bd6a5fa9.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"XAUES".**
